MIRALab · USTC · Hefei, China

About me

I'm an undergraduate student at USTC MIRALab, advised by Prof. Jie Wang. My work focuses on building agentic AI systems that can reason, plan, and learn from experience.

Currently I'm working on credit assignment for multi-step tool-using agents and LLM-guided adaptive tuning for solver configuration. I'm also exploring on-device LLM agent frameworks for mobile platforms.

Research

Agentic Reinforcement Learning

RL for multi-step tool-using and reasoning agents, self-evolving agentic systems.

Agentic Memory Systems

Long-term structured memory and retrieval for LLM agents.

Large Language Models

Post-training, alignment, and reasoning capabilities of LLMs.

Graph Reasoning

Structured knowledge representation and graph-based inference.
